create_flatten_dict_logger: create a FlattenDictLogger that wraps an existing logger and flattens nested dictionaries into top-level keys
build_logger_with_label_prefix: build a FlattenDictLogger with a custom label prefix to organize log keys under a named namespace
configure_raw_keys_for_logger: configure a FlattenDictLogger with raw_keys to exclude certain keys like step or timestamp from prefixing
write_flattened_log_data: write nested logging data through a FlattenDictLogger that automatically flattens sub-dictionaries into flat key paths
close_flatten_dict_logger: close a FlattenDictLogger instance which delegates the close call to the wrapped logger
